newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling slightly weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling slightly weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling traded a touch weaker against the dollar on Friday in quiet trading, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 56.00 against the dollar from 55.99 on Wednesday. Against sterling it was posted at an average of 87.76 from 87.55 on Wednesday.

"The shilling closed a touch weaker against the dollar as interest in dollar buying was experienced from the oil sector," a dealer said. "The market opened at 55.95/05 and moved up to close at 56.00/10.
"Trade was limited as players kept square positions," he said. "The 55.90/15 is seen as a near-term stability point for the dollar/shilling in the absence of major factors.

Dealers said the overnight money market was inactive owing to a central bank function which kept the clearing house closed on Wednesday for a visit by President Daniel arap Moi and on Thursday for a domestic holiday.
